name: RareStakingV1 universal Merkle-root update
summary: RareStakingV1.updateMerkleRoot() attempted to restrict callers with require(msg.sender != owner() || msg.sender != 0xc2F394a45e994bc81EfF678bDE9172e10f7c8ddc). Because the owner and fixed address were distinct, at least one inequality was true for every possible caller, making Merkle-root replacement permissionless. The attacker deployed a helper, set the root to keccak256(abi.encodePacked(helper, the staking proxy's full RARE balance)), and called claim() with that amount and an empty proof in the same transaction, draining the proxy.
notes: Proxy creation transaction 0x146c6690...a2613 emitted Upgraded(address) at log 457 selecting RareStakingV1 0xffb512b9176d527c5d32189c3e310ed4ab2bb9ec, which had been deployed one transaction earlier. It is the only Upgraded event from proxy creation through the pre-incident block. The EIP-1967 implementation slot continuously identifies that artifact, whose runtime code hash is unchanged from implementation deployment through block 23016422.

The RARE balance of staking proxy 0x3f4d749675b3e48bccd932033808a7079328eb48 is exactly 11907874.713019104529057960 RARE immediately before the anchor and zero afterward. The claim calldata, TokensClaimed event, and RARE Transfer log all independently record that full amount. This is gross asset loss from the staking proxy; later movement and sale of the same tokens are attacker realization and are not added again. DefiLlama's nearest historical RARE observation is 0.061452 USD at timestamp 1753689540, 1379 seconds before the exploit, valuing the loss at 731762.71686445 USD. The seed row's 730000 USD amount is a rounded estimate.
